instruction: Open or import the initial file(s) from the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\chamfer_plate.step. Use T2 to create 0.5 mm Chamfer operations on the top outside contour and all four hole mouths of C:\Users\User\Desktop\chamfer_plate.step. The chamfer toolpath must cover the outside contour and every hole opening. Tool definition: T2 is a 90 degree chamfer mill used for all 0.5 mm chamfers. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-5.nc.
